description.en: Same as AddParty_Message, but shows the "sysmes-back_party" message (a member rejoining) instead of "sysmes-add_party".
Param ID of the character to add back to the party.
Whether to lock the member's position slot.
Whether to enable the member's Fighting Spirit.
Whether to lock the member's Fighting Spirit.
Level to set for the member.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Bringing a member back without changing their level (real usage, from ev42061300.nut)
examples.code:
// Bring a party member back with the "rejoined" presentation, keeping their current level
AddParty_Message_Back("para_cp0010", true, true, true);

examples.case: Bringing a member back and setting their level
examples.code:
// Bring a party member back with the "rejoined" presentation and set their level to 18
AddParty_Message_Back("para_cp0015", true, false, false, 18);
